metadata.title: 番号を小さい順に集めたマスが長方形になる段階を、交換後も数える
metadata.summary: 格子の各頂点を囲む四マスから形を評価し、長方形となる条件を最小値4で表す。二マスの交換を少数の区間加算に直し、全ての段階の答えを更新する。

reference.title: 座席 (Seats)
reference.evidence: 長方形格子の全マスに0..HW−1を一つずつ置き、二番号の交換後に長方形を埋める非空番号prefixの個数を返す。外側を白とした2×2窓の黒1個・3個の個数の合計は常に4以上で、4と長方形が同値。四番号のソートから寄与する二区間を求め、影響する高々八頂点の古い寄与を除去して新しい寄与を加え、range add/min/countで全prefixを同時に管理できる。
reference.verificationNotes: 2026-10-15に主催公式原典と公式Reviewを再読し、主催者配布POL/IDN翻訳の検索本文でH,W正、HW<=1000000、Q1..50000、全座標相異/範囲、0<=a,b<HWかつa!=bを確認。原典画像を読んだとは主張しない。Reviewの黒1個窓4個/黒3個窓なし条件は通常web抽出で読めるが、他の数式の完全な転記は未確認。後年のTomasz Idziaszek本人による詳細解説を公式Reviewと区別した。C1>=4、C3=0から各4近傍成分が矩形、対角接触グラフの平面性/三角形なしとC1=4B−2Dによる等号条件、四番号の半開二区間、重複除去した局所swap、min/count不変条件を独立に証明。実MDX単一可視完全C++20を抽出し、全形HW<=8の174569置換・4773592 swap対、74938 bitmap、400乱択の240000累積swap、100万マス5形それぞれ原典最大50000swapと不正API/copy/moveを照合。通常/ASan+UBSanとも16930653 checks、checksum3501807229918974063。通常8.28754秒/70540KiB、san36.051秒/642472KiB。競技日2018-09-03はJP委員会公式日別一覧、難度null。

problemFeature.title: 座席 (Seats)
features: H×Wの全マスへ0〜HW−1を一つずつ置く。番号0からtまでの集合が、穴のない一つの軸平行長方形を埋めるtの個数を数える。
操作は二番号の位置の交換で、その直後の個数を多数回返す。外側は常に空で、境界や一行・一列も扱う。
H,W>=1、HW<=1000000、交換1..50000回、番号0..HW−1。原典a!=bを包含し、掲載APIは同番号交換も明示的に扱う。
problemFeature.notes: 長方形格子の全マスに0..HW−1を一つずつ置き、二番号の交換後に長方形を埋める非空番号prefixの個数を返す。外側を白とした2×2窓の黒1個・3個の個数の合計は常に4以上で、4と長方形が同値。四番号のソートから寄与する二区間を求め、影響する高々八頂点の古い寄与を除去して新しい寄与を加え、range add/min/countで全prefixを同時に管理できる。

subsequentSolutionReview.notes: 局所2×2のC1+C3最小値4の必要十分性を多成分/穴/対角接触まで独立に証明し、四番号ソートによる半開二区間、外部sentinel、影響頂点のunique化、min/count/lazy、O(P)初期化とO(logP)swapを完全C++20/API化した。実MDXから抽出した掲載コードが独立bbox oracleと通常/ASan+UBSanで16930653 checks、checksum3501807229918974063に一致。初回固定auditのclassificationや初回未実装fieldsを書き換えず、登録後のresolutionとして追加可能。

api.constructor: PrefixRectangleGrid(int height,int width,const std::vector<int>& row,const std::vector<int>& column)
api.input: height,width positive, product1..1000000; coordinate arrays indexed by label0..P−1, exact lengthP, in range and pairwise distinct; checked fully
api.swapRange: each label0..P−1; arbitrary order; a==b is a no-op extension validated only after BOTH indices
api.result: number of nonempty label prefixes0..t that equal a filled axis-parallel rectangle; single cells, rows, columns included
api.queryCount: No count state/cap. OriginalQ<=50000 covered by O(P+QlogP); get-current is O(1).
api.updateErrors: std::invalid_argument before mutation on either invalid label, including equal invalid labels
api.stateErrors: std::logic_error from current/update on moved-from objects before other validation
api.copyMove: deep-copy construction; noexcept move resets source size to0; pass-by-value copy-swap assignment preserves target on parameter-copy failure; self-copy/self-move preserve data
api.allocationErrors: standard allocation exceptions propagate from construction/copy; no allocation during valid swap; failed constructor yields no object
integerSafety: Reject dimensions outside1..1000000 before signed multiplication; int64 product<=10^12 then reject product>10^6 before int conversion.
All row-major cell indices and labels are0..P−1; vertex coordinates0..H/0..W; each<=10^6. Tree storage4P and node indices<4P.
V=(H+1)(W+1)<=4P. Each local odd-black window contributes0/1. Unique-window removal followed by unique-window addition leaves every actual intermediate score in[0,V].

Every stored tree minimum was last refreshed with all ancestor lazy values pushed, so it is an actual past/current subinterval minimum in[0,V]. For an internal node lazy=min(node)−min(stale child minima); a leaf lazy=min(node)−initial score. Thus all lazy magnitudes<=V, independent of Q, and adding bounded operands stays<=2V<=8P.
Initial diff endpoints sum at most2V interval events, hence magnitude<=2V<=8P. min counts<=P. static_assert int max>=100000000 covers every required intermediate<=8000000.
Each swap uses exactly eight fixed-array slots before sort+unique; vertex endpoints fit. Midpoints use left+(right−left)/2. No recursive grid traversal or machine-sized bit shifts.
api.time: O(P) preprocessing, O(logP) per swap, O(1) current; O(P+QlogP) overall
api.space: O(P); three tree int arrays of4P plus grid/position ofP; diffP+1 only during initialization
api.memoryScope: payload sizes exclude caller-owned row/column, allocator metadata, object overhead and sanitizer bookkeeping; no original memory-limit value invented

proof.lowerBound: At the topmost black row, its leftmost/rightmost cells give two distinct one-black windows above; bottommost row gives two distinct ones below, even a singleton. Hence C1>=4 and C1+C3=4 forces C3=0.
proof.componentRectangles: When no3-black window exists, overlapping maximal black runs of adjacent rows must have identical endpoints; any differing endpoint gives a3-black window. Propagation over a4-connected component yields one fixed interval over consecutive rows, hence one filled rectangle.
proof.diagonalContacts: Different rectangle components only touch diagonally at isolated grid vertices. Each pair touches at most once. At a contact two individual one-black corners disappear into a two-black window, so C1=4B−2D.
proof.planarTriangleFree: Connecting interior points of the disjoint rectangles through contacts yields a simple planar contact graph. Three pairwise-touching axis-parallel closed rectangles have a common point by interval Helly in each coordinate; three distinct components meeting there force side adjacency, contradiction. Thus no triangle.
proof.equality: B2 givesD<=1 henceC1>=6; B>=3 givesD<=2B−4 henceC1>=8. ThereforeC1=4/C3=0 forcesB1 and a rectangle. A rectangle conversely has exactly four1-black windows and no3-black windows.
proof.intervals: For sorted local labels a<=b<=c<=d, odd black cardinality at thresholdt occurs precisely on[a,b) or[c,d). Exterior sentinelP never turns black; duplicate sentinels create empty ranges.
proof.localSwap: Only grid vertices incident to either swapped cell can change; collect their eight occurrences, sort+unique, remove each old contribution once, swap grid and label-position arrays, add each new contribution once.
proof.minimumCount: Each segment stores minimum and number of leaves attaining it, with uniform pending addition. Lower-bound4 and full-grid-prefix4 fix global minimum at4; the root count is exactly the answer after the whole transaction.
proof.initialization: Add local half-open intervals to a difference array inO(V), prefix sum for allP scores, then recursively build tree inO(P). Avoid O(PlogP) repeated range initialization.

guards.feature: 長方形格子の全マスへ0..HW−1を一つずつ置き、非空番号prefixが一つの軸平行長方形をちょうど埋めるかを数える。
各操作は二番号の位置の交換であり、交換のたびに全prefixの該当個数を求める。
H,W>=1、HW<=1000000。全体O(HW+Qlog(HW))時間・O(HW)空間を使える。原典Q<=50000を含む。

verification.bitmapShapes: all positive H,W<=4, every nonempty bitmap
verification.oracle: For each arrangement scan label0..P−1 literally, maintain min/max row/column, and accept a prefix iff bounding-box area equals prefix cardinality. It uses no local corner formula, interval contribution, lazy tree or range-add logic. Every accepted set fills its bbox because all cell coordinates are distinct.
verification.exhaustiveProcedure: For every placement in every HW<=8 shape, check construction, every same-label no-op, EVERY unordered pair swap against independent bbox oracle, getter, then reversed swap to restore the same instance. No corner implementation shared by oracle.
verification.extraCriterionCheck: Direct1-/3-black window counts versus literal bboxarea==popcount for all74938 nonempty bitmaps withH,W<=4, separately from the answer oracle. Covers holes, multiple components and arbitrary diagonal contacts.
verification.randomOracle: Seed20180903,400 arbitrary permutations withH,W1..13;600 cumulative swaps per instance. Every answer equals literal bbox scan. Separate transposed/reflected owned models receive the identical swaps and must match too.

maximumCases.oracle: Fora<b only prefixesendinga..b−1 change. In a line the count isP−(b−a)+(a==0?(b==1?1:2):0), independently derived from contiguous positions.
